caption: The drawing features a wooden rocking horse placed centrally on a neutral, light beige background. The rocking horse has a light brown body with visible wear and marks, and it is shaped with a simple, rounded head, two upright ears, an elongated neck, and four angular legs. The saddle area is depicted with two darker brown, curved seat pieces attached to the back, creating a place for a child to sit. The horse stands on two curved green rockers, which are thick and attached securely to its legs, allowing it to move back and forth. Between the rockers, a rectangular wooden footrest, colored in a dull brownish-gray, is mounted horizontally to provide a stable place for feet. The image includes no other objects or background details, and the composition highlights the form and construction of the rocking horse.
title: Rocking Horse
